# /

Two jobs on one route. It is the bouncer that keeps a signed-out person off
every other screen, and it is "today's prompt," the entry point for the daily
create loop.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Route | `/` |
| Router file | `app/index.tsx` |
| Flows | F1 Launch and authentication, F4 Daily create and submit |
| Position in flow | F1's landing point after sign-in; F4's step 1, the prompt read |
| Data calls | two reads, `getTodayPrompt` and `getStreak` (via `/me/stats`) |
| Shared surface | `BottomNav`, `ScreenHeader` |

Cited to hs2studio/scribl-app at `c1b3c2d` on `main`, clean tree.

## Features

| Feature | Where it lives |
|---------|----------------|
| Bounce a signed-out person to sign-up | `app/index.tsx:44-46` |
| Read and show today's prompt, with a date badge | `app/index.tsx:96-108` |
| Retry the prompt load on failure | `app/index.tsx:90-92` |
| Show a live countdown to the prompt's close | `app/index.tsx:38-41`, `:117-123` |
| Show the current streak | `app/index.tsx:125-130` |
| Open the canvas, labelled by whether today is already submitted | `app/index.tsx:140-146` |
| Navigate to home, draw, or settings via the bottom nav | `app/index.tsx:150-156` |

## Data calls

| Client method | Endpoint | Handler |
|---------------|----------|---------|
| `getTodayPrompt()` | `GET /prompt/today` | `backend/lambda/handlers/today-prompt.ts` |
| `getStreak()` | `GET /me/stats` | derives from `computeStreaks()`, `src/data/http.ts:149-154` |

Neither call is made directly by the screen. `load()` off `usePromptStore` and
`loadStreak()` off `useStreakStore` both fire from mount effects gated on
`currentUser` being set (`app/index.tsx:49-61`), so no request goes out before
the bouncer check resolves.

## State in, state out

**Reads on entry.** `useAuthStore`'s `hydrated` and `currentUser`
(`app/index.tsx:34-35`), `usePromptStore`'s `data`/`loading`/`error`
(`app/index.tsx:27`), `useStreakStore`'s `current`/`loading`/`error`
(`app/index.tsx:28-33`).

**The bounce.** `app/index.tsx:43-47` replaces to `/sign-up` once `hydrated`
is true and `currentUser` is `null`. Until `hydrated` flips, the screen shows
a bare loading spinner (`app/index.tsx:63-71`) rather than either the bounce
or the prompt, so a slow hydrate cannot flash the wrong screen.

**Writes on mount.** None from this screen directly; it triggers loads in the
two stores above but writes nothing itself.

**Writes on exit.** None. Navigation to `/draw`, `/home`, or `/settings` is a
plain `router.push` (`app/index.tsx:143`, `:152-154`).

## Components

| Component | Path |
|-----------|------|
| `ScreenHeader` | `components/nav/ScreenHeader.tsx`, used at `app/index.tsx:75` |
| `BottomNav` | `components/nav/BottomNav.tsx`, used at `app/index.tsx:151` |
| `Button`, `Text` | `components/ui/button.tsx`, `components/ui/text.tsx` |

`BottomNav` and `ScreenHeader` are generic chrome reused across the app's
non-onboarding screens; nothing about this page's use of them is special.

## Notes for planning

Authored here, not read out of the app.

### One route, two flow identities, no visible seam

The inventory lists this route under both F1 and F4 (`product/design/screen-flow-inventory.md`),
and the source backs that up: the bounce logic (`:44-46`) is pure F1, the
prompt-and-streak body is pure F4. A person who lands here mid-flow cannot
tell which job just ran; the screen looks identical either way. That is fine
for a POC, but a production build that wants to log "sign-in complete" versus
"opened today's prompt" as distinct events needs to instrument the bounce
separately from the render.

### The loading state has no error branch of its own

If `hydrate()` in the auth store fails, `hydrated` still becomes `true`
(`src/stores/useAuthStore.ts:194-197`), so the bounce still runs correctly.
But there is no visible sign anywhere on this screen that the hydrate attempt
failed; a person just sees the normal sign-up bounce with no explanation.
Acceptable for a POC's stubbed auth, worth a real message before this ships.
